title: VIRTUAL SINGER Chapter1 Episode8 All-Out Show!

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The show's about to start, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It sure is! Let's put on another fantastic show today, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's make this the best show yet!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, we need to remember to be careful, though. Our set list is different than usual today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wonder if it would be better to change positions a bit sooner right before the interlude of the second song.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You mean what we talked about that during rehearsal? We need to move to stage right as soon as the interlude begins, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Right!
I think that will make it easier to move into the next part of the routine.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Got it! I'll try to be a bit quicker than you since I'll be coming from the opposite end of the stage.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sounds good! Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: All right, let's get out there and give it all we've got♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hi everyone! Thank you for coming today!
bgm_area00002

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We hope you enjoy the show! Let's have some fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Good, we're off to a great start! Time to move so we can get the crowd even more fired up with our interlude dance!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Huh? Rin should have started moving to stage right by now.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: All right, everyone! Let's hear those voices!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (What?! She hasn't moved, yet?!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Did she get so wrapped up in the moment that she forgot about what we discussed?!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (In that case, I'll have to get her attention!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Rin! You need to move over here!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is everyone enjoying the show?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She's not noticing me at all.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Only one thing to do, then!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So far, so good! Now it's time to...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(Hm? I feel like I'm forgetting something.
Oh, that's right!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I was supposed to move to the other side of the stage! What do I do? My dance with Miku is going to—)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin! Over here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?! Miku?! What are you doing over here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If I come over here next to you, then you'll be able to do your dance just like usual!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: R-Right! Thanks, Miku! Sorry about that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You ready, then?! Time to dance♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Come on, everyone!
Time to get those hands waving to the beat!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are you ready? Okay, let's go!
After the show

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Great job today, Rin.
The crowd sure was having fun out there!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, Rin. What do you say we go say hi to those four after we...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? What's the matter, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sorry about today. I completely forgot about the change.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Don't worry about it!
You were focused on getting the crowd all fired up!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's just be more careful next time and put on another great show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay. I will.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Shall we go backstage and do our post-show stretches?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I have something I need to do real quick.
Would you start without me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be waiting!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, Rin! Where are you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's strange. She said she'd be back soon.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I wonder where she went.
We always do our stretches together after a show. Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mmm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is that Rin lying on the ground?! A-Are you all right?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Snore*...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, good. She's just sleeping. Hehe. She must be exhausted.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? What's all this spread out on the ground?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, these are all notes on our past shows. She even wrote down her ideas on how to improve specific parts. Look at all the notes about just today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She must always put in so much work thinking about our next show.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Rin.
I'll do my best to make our next show great, too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Mumble*...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, I know. There's a blanket in the rehearsal room.
 I'll go grab it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I had planned for us to go say hi to everyone, but...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Snore*...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd hate to wake her up. Maybe I'll go by myself this time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good night, Rin.
